subject.title: Add native PowerShell smoke coverage for contributor commands

question: Should OpenClaw add recurring native PowerShell smoke coverage for `check:docs`, `build:strict-smoke`, or a narrower command set in the existing Windows CI lane?
rationale: The request fits test-infrastructure priorities, but it changes recurring Windows CI scope and the active candidate still needs command-set and proof decisions before merge.

options.title: Land After Passing Proof
options.body: Accept the native PowerShell smoke lane after the selected commands pass on Windows and the PR body includes redacted real behavior evidence.

options.title: Start Narrower
options.body: Limit the first smoke lane to commands that already pass under native PowerShell, then expand after build-smoke coverage is proven stable.

options.title: Defer CI Cost
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not land recurring Windows smoke coverage until runner budget or release priorities justify it.

recommendation.title: Land After Passing Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the native PowerShell smoke lane after the selected commands pass on Windows and the PR body includes redacted real behavior evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent overlap across CI workflow stabilization and PowerShell-safe docs tooling.
